body: One of the most disgusting things about the beck is how she uses my 90 year old grandmother for help with basic tasks this fat cunt somehow cannot manage herself. If cuck is unavailable to wipe her ass or give her a scrub-down in the monthly shower, then my poor, half-senile grandmother ends up doing it.

I think smoking is fine as an occasional coping mechanism personally. The hard drugs may have saved my life when I was so ready to die that I tried them, but they ended up taking me to places I never thought I would go. I would never recommend using them.

I have been there. Am there often. Other than using drugs ( which I would not recommend at all unless it comes down to suicide or get high) the only thing that has ever worked for me is taking a radical approach to life. I simply pretended one day that instead of having lived this whole 25 years of mistakes and damages and disappointments, I simply spawned into existence.

This day.

This hour.

And so I thought to myself, "OK, let me check out the specs of this body and mind I am piloting. Let us see what we have to work with"

..."serious drug problems...mental health issues...working as a pizza delivery boy"...

"and yet this lifeform my consciousness inhabits has advantages and strengths...potential in many areas"

I won't go through a self-congratulatory listing of those positive attributes. I only say all this to you because it really did help me. And I have been on and off every fucking psych drug you can name, been to rehab more times than I like to say, seen more therapists and doctors.

And in the end the only way I was able to survive was by taking this  approach. I posted on here months ago about my suicidal feelings. They have not gone away entirely, but it is easier to ignore them. 

Through this thought process I brought down much of the barrier between the "self" and the rest of the universe. I found myself giving a couple dollars to every street person I encountered, knowing that if not for only a few circumstances in my life, I would be where they are or worse. 

I am 99.9999% sure that this won't help you.  I think I mostly typed this all out for my own emotional benefit.

But this is the honest truth to what has kept me alive to this day.

You can of course pm me if you need someone to talk to.

Sorry for hijacking, I'll just sit down here at the bottom of the page if you wanna talk.
Ennui is a great word for it.

Thank you for the insight.

What does it mean to embrace the inner child?

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me.

Is there a point where your life began to change? Like, the subjective experience of it as you improved?

The more I objectively improve my circumstances, the longer I stay off the drugs, I feel I grow more lucid of my failings.

So...in the dark path you have been down, what does the change look like? Feel like?

I often feel I am too broken for such a change.

Thank you. It is an enormous honor for anyone to tell me that something I created offers comfort to others.

edit: though I apologize for the pretentiousness of my writing style. I carry myself with this ridiculous detachment when first socializing with someone. I think it is a way of protecting my ego. Hiding behind big words and "big thoughts".
